kebab_example: aliyun yike create-yike-user --workspace-id llm-az2gglkjauwnnhpq --user-name-prefix test --nickname nick --password 000 --production-ids id1,id2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateYikeUser

parameters.help_en:
The username prefix of the sub-account. Rules:

- Maximum 50 characters. Must be unique within the workspace.
- The system automatically generates the user logon name in the following format: {UserNamePrefix}.{Workspace Code}@{Alibaba Cloud UID}.yikeai
parameters.help_zh:
子账号用户名前缀，规则为：

- 最多 50 个字符，且需在工作室内保持唯一性。
- 系统将自动生成用户登录名，格式为：{UserNamePrefix}.{工作室 Code}@{阿里云 UID}.yikeai
parameters.name: user_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the sub-account user
parameters.name: nickname

parameters.help_en:
The associated projects. Multiple projects are supported, separated by commas.
> 
> - A single user can be added to multiple projects
parameters.help_zh:
关联项目，支持多个，逗号隔开。
> 
> - 同一个用户可以加入多个项目
parameters.name: production_ids
